program.name: Glute Volume
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Three glute days: bridges and thrusts, swings and hinges, then step-ups and kickbacks.
program.about: The glutes from three directions. Hip thrusts and loaded bridges drive them straight; swings, deadlifts and good mornings train them from the hinge; step-ups, curtsy lunges, kickbacks and side-lying raises work one side at a time. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bridge & thrust / swing & hinge / step-up & kickback
